question: Should OpenClaw adopt the proposed experimental Claw-package model for portable, complete agents and its cross-owner lifecycle across OpenClaw and ClawHub?
rationale: This is a new user-facing capability with an enduring package and compatibility contract. Source inspection can assess coherence, but cannot determine whether maintainers want to own this product direction.

options.title: Sponsor the experimental contract
options.body: Accept a bounded experimental Claws direction and designate an owner to validate and land the dependent implementation stack incrementally.

options.title: Narrow to approved primitives
options.body: Revise the RFC to describe only presently accepted extension surfaces and defer portable-agent lifecycle commitments.

options.title: Defer core adoption
options.body: Pause the RFC until a maintainer-sponsored roadmap decision establishes whether this package model belongs in core.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the experimental contract
recommendation.body: Accept a bounded experimental Claws direction and designate an owner to validate and land the dependent implementation stack incrementally.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main RFC template and contribution policy make this the strongest available routing candidate for an acceptance decision.
